question: The Ahaia Winter Festival is primarily organised by the North-Eastern state of __________ to promote tourism.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ahaia Winter Festival** is primarily organized by the North-Eastern state of **Meghalaya** to promote tourism.
 
• It provides a platform to showcase the vibrant traditions, music, art, and craftsmanship of Meghalaya, particularly **those of the Garo, Khasi, and Jaintia tribes.**
 
• The **term "Ahaia" translates to "celebration" in the Garo language, **reflecting the festival's spirit of joy and unity.
 
• The festival is **typically held in December, with events spanning several days.**
 
• The main venue is often the **Dikki Bandi Stadium** in Tura.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tripura**:

 
 
• **Kharchi Puja** is the most significant festival in Tripura, celebrated primarily in the **Agartala** area.
 
• It is dedicated to **14 deities**, worshipped as the clan gods of the Tripuri people.
 
• This week-long festival is marked by sacrifices, prayers, and vibrant cultural performances.
 
• **Garia Puja** is another important festival in Tripura, primarily observed by the indigenous Tripuri community, where prayers are offered to the deity of agriculture for a good harvest.
 
 
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh**:
 
 
• The **Losar Festival** is one of the most prominent festivals in Arunachal Pradesh, celebrated by the **Monpa** community.
 
• It marks the start of the Tibetan New Year and is a time for family gatherings, feasts, and traditional dances.
 
• Another notable festival is **Buddha Jayanti**, celebrated by the Buddhist community, where the birth, enlightenment, and death of Lord Buddha are commemorated with prayers and rituals.
 
 
 
• **Sikkim**:
 
 
• **Lhosar**, the **Tibetan New Year**, is a major celebration in Sikkim, observed with various cultural events, traditional food, prayers, and dances.
 
• The festival marks the beginning of the New Year according to the Tibetan calendar and is celebrated by the Sikkimese people with much enthusiasm.
 
• **Buddha Jayanti** is also celebrated in Sikkim, particularly by the Buddhist community, to honour the life and teachings of Lord Buddha, with prayers and processions in monasteries.
